harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired `/srv/legacy2/archive-member-safety/bin/unpack` on node1. It now preflights complete archives before extraction, accepts normal nested files, rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, unsafe links, symlink-descendant escapes, duplicate paths, special members, and unreadable payloads. Source packages and protected data remain unchanged. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were preserved. The repair persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced the unsafe direct `tar -xf` implementation with archive-wide validation and hardened extraction using the platform's existing Python 3.12.
Verified all malformed supplied packages are rejected before installing members.
Confirmed source package and protected-file hashes remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 once using the native safe reboot mechanism and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.
Repeated functional and integrity checks after restart.
